question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The door which __connecting__ the two offices is kept locked.
solution:
The correct answer is: **connects**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The underlined segment "**which connecting**" in the original sentence contains a grammatical error.
 
• The correct option is "**connects**."
 
• In the given sentence, "**which**" is used as a relative pronoun to introduce the relative clause.
 
• The correct verb form to use after "**which**" in this context is "**connects**."
 
• "**Connects**" is the **present tense verb** that **agrees **with the **singular subject** "**door**."
 
• The corrected sentence is: "*The door which connects the two offices is kept locked.*"
 
• The corrected sentence maintains proper grammar and conveys the intended meaning that the door connecting the two offices is kept locked.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.
